dedupe_keys.name: 114年度1745條土石流潛勢溪流集水區圖 dams reservoirs and flood defences and landslides and debris flows series on taiwan government open data platform

description: 114年度1745條土石流潛勢溪流集水區圖 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences and landslides and debris flows] (series on Taiwan Government Open Data Platform) is a series of datasets listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 農業部. 提供114年度1745條土石流集水區圖shp下載檔案，內容包含Debrisno(土石流潛勢溪流編號)、Rarea(集水區面積(ha))、CentroidX(集水區形心X坐標)、CentroidY(集水區形心Y坐標)、Dbnoold(溪流舊編號)等欄位。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal lists 16 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 農業部. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp. The portal shows 2025-09-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
